snippet.title: Remnants of Sin: First Look Trailer
snippet.description:
The Demo is now live on Steam. You are invited to try it.

Remnants of Sin: Deck and Echoes blends roguelike deck-building with block-based combat. Every card you play becomes a tile you place as you fight your way through the Underworld.

You play as the amnesiac Knight of Regret, carving a path downward. The truth behind your fall will reveal itself along the journey.

The Demo includes the full first chapter, roughly 30 minutes of gameplay, featuring more than 60 cards, over 10 enemy types, and more than 20 relics.

If you want to see more content, please wishlist the game on Steam.
Your support matters to us.
